title: cystopteris protrusa
intro: Cystopteris protrusa, commonly known as the Protruded Bladder Fern, is a species of fern within the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris protrusa are attributed to its ability to soothe irritated tissues and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
